stories.title: 2-Year Treasury Yield Hits Multi-Year High After Fed Rate Hike
stories.summary: The 2-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level in several years following a Federal Reserve rate hike. The move shows markets resetting short-term rate expectations. Longer-dated yields also moved as investors repositioned.
stories.whyItMatters: Short-term Treasury yields feed directly into borrowing costs and equity valuations, so a fresh multi-year high points to tighter financial conditions ahead.
whatToWatch: The Fed's next policy signals and rate guidance
Reaction across the rest of the Treasury yield curve
Impact on rate-sensitive equity sectors
questions: Will the Fed keep raising rates or pause after this hike?
How much further can the 2-year yield climb?

stories.title: Dow Slides as Treasury Yields Hit 5%; Chip Equipment Makers Lead Nasdaq 100
stories.summary: The Dow came under pressure as Treasury yields rose to 5%, while semiconductor equipment stocks jumped and led gains on the Nasdaq 100. The split shows rate-sensitive blue chips lagging even as select chip-linked names rally.
stories.whyItMatters: A 5% yield level raises the bar for equity valuations broadly, but continued strength in chip-equipment stocks signals investor appetite for AI-linked hardware remains intact.
whatToWatch: Whether Treasury yields hold above 5% or retreat
Follow-through buying in chip equipment stocks
Market breadth beyond the index-level gains
questions: Can Nasdaq strength hold up if yields stay elevated?

stories.title: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Slip as Bond Yields Rise
stories.summary: All three major U.S. stock indexes slipped as bond yields moved higher, weighing on equity valuations broadly. The pullback reflects growing concern about rising borrowing costs.
stories.whyItMatters: Simultaneous declines across the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq point to broad rate sensitivity rather than a single-sector issue.
whatToWatch: The direction of bond yields in coming sessions
Whether the slide broadens into a deeper pullback
questions: Is this a rate-driven pause or the start of a larger selloff?

stories.title: Dow Falls for a Third Straight Week While Nasdaq Manages a Gain
stories.summary: The Dow logged its third straight weekly decline, even as the Nasdaq posted a weekly gain. The split performance points to a divide between rate-sensitive blue chips and tech-heavy names.
stories.whyItMatters: A diverging Dow-Nasdaq trend suggests investors are rotating between sectors rather than exiting stocks broadly, which matters for positioning.
whatToWatch: Whether the Dow's losing streak extends to a fourth week
Whether the Nasdaq's relative strength holds amid rising yields
questions: What is driving the Dow-Nasdaq divergence this cycle?
